offering_description.value: Investment adviser that manages mutual funds, exchange-traded funds and separate accounts across equity, fixed income and other strategies. It sells these to fund shareholders and institutional clients and earns fees on the assets it manages.

primary_products.value: mutual funds; exchange-traded funds; separately managed accounts

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual investors holding its funds and managed accounts; B2B: institutional clients, retirement plans and financial advisors

end_markets.value: financial services; retirement savings; institutional investing

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: advisory fees charged as a percentage of assets under management

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: pools client money into funds and accounts, sold to individual and institutional investors

geography_served.value: US national: clients and fund shareholders across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: mutual funds, exchange-traded funds and separate accounts, all investment management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales team selling to institutions and consultants; partners / resellers: broker-dealers and fund platforms that offer its funds to investors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: registered investment adviser and fund manager under SEC rules and the Investment Company Act of 1940

notes: Exact split of assets across products and clients is not certain.
